research_scope: Official paper, official code metadata and six bounded implementation files only. No benchmark task bodies, pretrained model binaries, or reserved Duet162 specifications opened.

official_paper.title: BUSTLE: Bottom-Up Program Synthesis Through Learning-Guided Exploration
official_paper.mechanism: Run candidate subprograms on disclosed inputs, describe intermediate values relative to disclosed targets, predict membership in a solution, and reweight their later bottom-up expansion priority. This is established learned program-search guidance, not a new AI principle.

practical_properties.original_full_dimensions: For max3 inputs:160 example signature categorical positions +46 candidate positions =206; five-way onehot1030 exceeds current512 policy feature cap.
practical_properties.bounded_string_only_encoding: Three input fields need107 I/O predicates plus31 candidate predicates. Encode ALL_TRUE/ALL_FALSE as two indicators (MIXED=00) for276 dimensions, then bounded AST cost/op statistics. Type mismatch is not needed only if the DSL is declared string-only. For up to8 fields, use a frozen pooling/schema design or larger declared dimension; never silently truncate fields.
extra_fair_features: candidate-output length difference and normalized edit distance
practical_properties.fairness: Every heuristic and trained control receives identical feature information; no heldout score outputs, source oracle bodies, task-family metadata or accepted future ASTs.

buyer_verified_training_contract: Only after a complete proposal is committed and buyer-accepted, traverse its actual validated AST and evaluate proper subtrees on that past task diagnostic inputs.
A positive is a semantic vector/type matching a proper internal subtree of that particular verified successful program. It is not proof of unique necessity or globally useful synthesis.
The full root is excluded because it trivially matches the target; leaf inputs/constants are excluded or handled in a separately declared condition equally for all controls.

Negatives come from the already metered candidate trace for the same past task, excluding any vector/type matching a positive subtree. They mean not-in-this-solution, not impossible or useless in all other solutions.
Sample negatives with a fixed per-task/per-family seed and cap; balance or weight each accepted origin so long/repeated tasks cannot dominate.
Identical immutable label tuples, replay capacities, training order and update budget go to logistic, nonlinear/RFF, kNN, MLP and spiking rankers.
Current task diagnostics may condition priority, but current buyer score labels/accepted program cannot train the ranker until after its own final search result is committed and scored.
Never use source define-fun oracle ASTs to create training positives for tasks the agent did not solve. Source oracles remain buyer-side check labelers only.

Cold start is real: shallow verified programs may have no proper internal subtree positives. Report number of usable accepted origins and labels; do not conceal this with generated ground-truth programs.
search_integrity: Use identical typed DSL, operation set, source constants, lazy/error semantics, AST/interpreter and budget for all rankers.
Deduplicate by full output vector and type across every disclosed example; retain a deterministic smallest-cost representative.

Do not discard intermediate values merely because they are not target substrings; a later case/replacement operation may make them useful. Heuristics prioritize but do not create branch-specific grammar.
Use positive bounded priority penalties or weighted fair rounds, with unguided coverage reserve; learned rankings must not silently remove search completeness under the declared finite cap.
Bound candidate banks, AST depth/nodes, strings, primitive work, failed executions, ranker batch size, memory and elapsed CPU.
Batch ranking; official Java default batch1024 reflects that inference may cost more than interpreting a small program. Small spiking layers over50k candidates are still material overhead.
Record semantic candidates expanded, actual executed primitive work, total CPU/wall time and per-task buyer correctness, not classifier accuracy alone.
controls_and_gates: Mandatory: size-ordered semantic-deduplicated search, official-style substring/edit-distance property heuristic, strongest DEV-selected conventional learned ranker on identical labels, trained continuous/frozen-input spiking controls.

Main causal test: same neural model weights and candidate information with live scores versus shuffled/zeroed scores, plus frozen input and shuffled training-label controls. All use identical candidate engine and resource caps.
Freeze source course, semantic signatures, dedup, ranker configurations, negative sampling, matched training seeds and qualification gates before opening reserved task bodies.
Group task families, duplicated specifications and benchmark variants together. Split candidate examples by accepted source task, never random subtree rows from one program across train/test.

For online qualification, score each task before it updates any learner; provide later tasks only identical past buyer feedback. Report family-clustered and macro-task results; tasks from one family are dependent.

A neural usefulness claim requires heldout verified-program gains or lower complete service cost against the strongest control, with matched learning budget and meaningful margin across seeds. Better candidate membership AUC alone is insufficient.

Stop if property heuristics already reach the bounded grammar oracle or if inference/training overhead erases search savings. No guarantee that SNNs outperform MLP/kNN on categorical property signatures.
limits: The ranking target is a noisy membership proxy, not a causal label for useful programs.
Properties can alias semantically different programs on four examples; independent buyer score checks remain essential.
Buyer-success-only training has survivorship bias and cannot improve unexplored operations without an explicit fair bootstrap/coverage route.
A broader DSL can improve competence independently of learning; compare every branch on that same broader DSL.
Any success is bounded learned safe-program search, not general intelligence, a novel algorithm or consciousness.
